before him, high up in the air like a flag.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 yell Pretty ribbons! #CR#Mi#Gb#Yb#Bo#Rn#Ws#R for your lady!;
%1 yell Pretty ribbons! #CR#Mi#Gb#Yb#Bo#Rn#Ws#R for your horse!

Mobs.Name: radioactive assassin glow glowing
Mobs.LongDescription: The #bElysium#Y assassin glows with a dangerous light.
Mobs.Description:
This assassin has a faint glow to him.  The glow is native to a certain
group of explorers who have spent too long in a part of the caves known
as Sellafield.  They were long ago ensorcelled by a wicked wizard known
as A Tom (named after his cat, they say), and those who spend too long
there often glow.

Mobs.Name: gypsy queen
Mobs.LongDescription: The fiercely independent gypsy moves majestically through the faire.
Mobs.Description:
Named for the last tsarina of Russia, Alekxandra, the Queen of the
Gypsies descends from an ancient line of gypsies.  Her long nearly black
hair, pale as pale skin, and bright green eyes display a certain air of
mysticism, sensuality, and the knowledge of ancient and dark secrets of
ancestors past.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%85 ass E;%1emote stares at you imperiously

Mobs.Name: razputin
Mobs.LongDescription:
The evil Razputin whispers wickedly into the ears of all who will
listen.
Mobs.Description:
Razputin is one source of evil not yet eradicated by the brave Elysium 
warriors.  His is the quiet, sly evil of the whispering powermonger, the
quick, sly stab to the heart from a monk with an innocent face.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%8 em smiles slyly at you.;%6 em beckons you closer.

Objects.Name: shiny brass key
Objects.Description: A shiny brass key has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This shiny brass key looks like it might unlock something important. 
Better not lose it.

Objects.Name: twisted crank key
Objects.ShortDescription: a twisted key shaped like a crank
Objects.Description: A small twisted crank looks like a missing machine part.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This little crank looks like it was lost from some small machine.  Made
of tin, it may be too battered to work properly when once again
inserted into the place where it fits, wherever that may be!

Objects.Name: superhero cape
Objects.Description: Eeeep! looks like someone dropped a green and white flag!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large sheet of silk was assembled from smaller sheets of forest green
and gleaming white.  The actual cape rather resembles a flag, with the
Elfking's golden lion emblazoned in the center.  The cape attaches at
the shoulders and billows out behind as the Elfking walks, creating an
illusion of flight.

Objects.Name: Elfking's white gold crown
Objects.Description: A crown of great delicacy has been intricately wrought of white gold.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Brilliant diamonds and deep red rubies reflect the beauty of the circle
of white gold which forms this crown.  The materials to make the crown
were brought at great cost from the four corners of the world, a gift
to the Mighty Elfking from his grateful subjects.

Objects.Name: mighty hammer justice
Objects.Description: This hammer keeps evil at bay.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The Mighty Hammer of the Elfking is extremely heavy and carries a
Mighty WHAM! when it hits a target.  The Hammer of Justice is only
swung in the name of good, of course, and only kills evil targets.  It
is extremely large and quite heavy and although apparently made of
elven mithril, it feels too heavy to be solid mithril.

Objects.Name: wedding ring
Objects.Description: You can faintly see the letters N.h...a in this well-worn gold ring.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A heavy, antique gold wedding ring glows softly.  It has clearly been
worn for an elven lifetime, as the metal is no longer polished and
shiny.  On the inside of the ring the letters N.h...a still can be
read.

Objects.Name: cloak darkness dark shadow
Objects.Description: Something dark lies like a shadow on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A whirling cape of deepest black is there - and then it isn't.  A thing
of magic, it swirls darkness over everything that it touches.
Formless, shapeless, yet deep in its darkness.

Objects.Name: dress peasant buttercup
Objects.ShortDescription: a dress embroidered in a pattern of buttercups
Objects.Description: A pattern of yellow buttercups covers a pretty cotton peasant dress.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a princess' idea of a peasant dress ... made of softest
batiste, in a soft white and embroidered all over with yellow
buttercups.

Objects.Name: rat snake food snakefood
Objects.Description: #YThe rat scurries arout the cage, whiskers and tail twitching.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Placed here to keep the snake(s) well fed and content (so they don't
ogle the paying customers) the rats run in circles around the cage.
They know they are doomed.  They would need a ratman superhero to
rescue them.  These rats are just your standard rats ... gray, white,
and pink with a green striped tail.

Objects.Name: statue werewolf bronze
Objects.Description: #YA bronze statue of a wolf is so lifelike you want to touch it.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This canine has really sharp teeth!  And there is a look of
intelligence about his face that makes you wonder if there is something
more to this particular wolf than 4 paws and a lot of fur.  His
features have an almost human cast to them ... A small plaque shines 
at the foot of the statue.

It reads:
 
                    #wNightwolf#N

Objects.Name: statue granite pennyroyal
Objects.Description:
A large granite statue of the fearless warrior Pennyroyal stands
guard.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of the fearless warriors who led the charges to keep Elysium a land
of peace and harmony alas, Pennyroyal was also one of the first to fall
to the dreaded rl monster.  He stands here, immortalized in pink
granite for you to admire and revere.

Objects.Name: statue marble gutless
Objects.ShortDescription: a statue of the immortal Gutless
Objects.Description: An immense white marble statue of the immortal Gutless shines.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Patron saint of the #bElysium#N clan, the immortal Gutless has been
further immortalized in this immense statue of white marble, brought to
this site by grateful clansmen.

Objects.Name: chessboard
Objects.ShortDescription: a heavy black and white marble chessboard
Objects.Description:
A heavy black and white marble chessboard waits for you to make a
move.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This chessboard was "borrowed" from some upside down tower currently
inhabited by monsters.  It is large and made of black and white marble,
which nicely matches the black and white chess pieces.

Objects.Name: bag small demon
Objects.ShortDescription: a small bag made from the belly of some beast
Objects.Description: An evil little bag used to be the belly of an evil little beast.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is no wonder that the leather used to make this bag is
unrecognizable. The entire bag used to be the belly of a small,
hideously evil beast.  It feels right at home in the hands of a demon,
and warms to his touch.

Objects.Name: pickled frog lips jar glass
Objects.ShortDescription: a clear glass jar of pickled frog lips
Objects.Description: You can see pickled frog lips clearly through the glass of this jar.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These frog lips were "harvested" in a swamp infested with evil
creatures. It is said they possess great power when used in combination
with the right incantations and the right aspect of the moon.

Objects.Name: beak vulture hook hooked
Objects.ShortDescription: the hooked beak of a vulture
Objects.Description:
The hooked beak of a very large vulture has been severed from the
bird.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The vulture's beak and talons are awesome weapons for the vulture. 
Perhaps some of the fearless attack strength of the vulture is still
contained in this small piece of one.

Objects.Name: sleeves wizard velvet black
Objects.Description: Long, black velvet sleeves come to a point below your hand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The wizard's tailor has created long black velvet sleeves, soft and
light as a summer's breeze.  They are black inside and out, and end in
a long tapered point well below the wearer's hand.  This makes for a
very dramatic effect when the mage's arms are outstretched.  Of course,
effect is much of what magic is all about!

Objects.Name: helmet minotaur horned bronze
Objects.Description:
A bronze helmet with 4 sharp minotaur horns spiraling out of it just
might poke you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Four very long (about 18" or 45cm) horns were "harvested" from at least
two very (hopefully!) dead minotaurs, then attached to heavy bronze to
form this helmet that is half armor half weapon.  The horns are quite
sharp, and spiral out from the head.  The wearer must be very cautious
lest they become entangled in overhead trees, etc.

Objects.Name: broad leather belt
Objects.Description: A tiger's eye winks out at you from a broad leather belt.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A wide, tough leather belt has been fashioned from the hide of a
dinosaur. The skin itself is a beautiful bright gold, and in the center
of the belt is a huge tiger's eye jewel.
The jewel in the center of the belt seems to be winking at you.

Objects.Name: book wand
Objects.ShortDescription: a heavy leather-bound book of spells
Objects.Description: A thick book bound in deep brown leather lies here, collecting dust.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very large, heavy book looks very old.  Its bindings are cracking
with age, and although you can tell it was leather, it's not at all
clear what kind of leather it is.

Objects.Name: wizard walking boots skin lizard
Objects.Description: Made from the skin of a rare lizard, these boots reek of evil.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bejubula lizard is rare indeed.  In fact, they have been hunted
almost to extinction.  The lizard is uniquely beautiful when very
young, and has a sweet, innocent air about it.  It has a gentle,
nurturing nature, and is born with a large portion of innate magical
ability.  They are hunted down by ruthless evil hunters (primarily
drow), and their skin is made into a variety of leather objects.  Both
the evil of their early death and the magic of their life is retained
by the leather made from their skins.

Objects.Name: voodoo voo doo doll wand
Objects.Description: #YA #Mvo#wo#Mdoo#Y mage has created a small doll from soft wax.#N

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The small, anatomically correct doll has been carefully formed from
soft wax and dressed in cleverly fashioned gold armor.  In the right
hands, with the addition of some hair or nail clippings, this doll
might have some awesome powers.

Objects.Name: toad shriveled feet
Objects.Description: Some poor toad is obviously stumping around without his feet.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
From deep in some mysterious swamp, these toad feet have been brought
to the faire to be used in some dark magic.

Objects.Name: baseball cloth cap
Objects.ShortDescription: a small cloth cap with #bElysium#N on the crown
Objects.Description: A cloth cap with #bElysium#G on the crown is worn brim-backwards.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This linen cap has a most unusual construction.  The crown has been
formed of six sections of strong white linen, but there is a small gap
at the back which is closed by a leather strap-and-hook gadget.  There
is a large "bill", or brim, which covers just the front of the cap and
is meant to shade the eyes.  Above this brim, the words "#bElysium#N"
have been neatly stitched in bright blue letters.

Objects.Name: helmet green forest large
Objects.Description: This large forest green helmet will protect a #yTroll#G ranger's head.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Since #bElysium#N's #yTrollish#N rangers have taken to replenishing the
forest by pretending to be trees themselves, they've discovered a need
for some protection from the elements (including flying birds and
dragons). These helmets provide protection from acorns that the ferrets
love to pelt them with as well as the overhead bird bombs.

Objects.Name: hat soft dark green velvet rose
Objects.ShortDescription: a soft dark green velvet hat with big red rose
Objects.Description:
A soft dark green velvet hat with a big red rose waits for the right
face.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An expensive hat, to be sure, but one that makes the wearer beautiful.
It is a green so dark as to be almost black, with a wide brim that
shapes itself to frame your face.  It has been decorated with a large
red rose at one side and a wide black ribbon.

Objects.Name: violet ribbon
Objects.Description: A pretty violet ribbon has been dropped.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pretty violet ribbon would make a nice souvenir of the faire.  This
ribbon is the exact color of wood violets in the early morning.

Objects.Name: deep purple ribbon
Objects.Description: A deep purple ribbon might make you look royal!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A deep purple ribbon might be just the thing to take home as a souvenir
of this lovely faire!  It is a very dark purple, just about the color
of the small dragon you met on the path on the way up.  Perhaps you
could use it to bribe her should she get testy when you go home!

Objects.Name: buttercup yellow ribbon
Objects.Description: A ribbon yellow as buttercups would rather be worn than lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ribbon maker made this ribbon especially to please that elusive
princess, Buttercup.  She seems to have once again disappeared.  With
the favor of a royal princess, the ribbon maker would sell lots of this
color!

Objects.Name: gold ribbon
Objects.Description: A gold ribbon is quite a prize!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Although it is bought and not won, this gold ribbon is still pretty
impressive.  You could, of course, always SAY that it was won on the
battlefield!

Objects.Name: leaf green ribbon
Objects.ShortDescription: #ga ribbon the color of new leaves#N
Objects.Description: A new sprout of leaf green blows across the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Light green - the color the gnomish folk prefer - should be a big
seller at this faire with it's many gnomish visitors.

Objects.Name: forest green ribbon
Objects.Description: Rangers like this deep forest green ribbon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Do you know any rangers?  This forest green ribbon was just meant for
them!  The deep forest green is very nice with ranger uniforms!

Objects.Name: raspberry berry red ribbon
Objects.Description: Raspberry juice must have been used to stain this ribbon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A cheerful bright red ribbon was designed to attract the eye of the
faire-going peasant.  Stuck in a life of dull browns and tans and
greens, this raspberry red ribbon would liven up their clothing.

Objects.Name: crimson ribbon
Objects.Description: A deep crimson red ribbon looks like a trail of blood.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The deep crimson of this ribbon is for lovers to share.  It is the
color of a true heart's blood.

Objects.Name: bright white ribbon
Objects.Description: A bright white ribbon is for chastity and weddings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This glaringly white ribbon could adorn a wedding dress.  With all the
activity of a faire, it will probably not stay pure white for very
long. Perhaps that should make it all that much more prized.

Objects.Name: black ribbon
Objects.Description: Black is the color of night and mourning.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some knights will forfeit their lives in the jousts today.  Old
rivalries will be solved in a permanent fashion, and widows and
servants of the recently passed will adorn themselves with black
ribbons.

Objects.Name: Elysium blue bright ribbon
Objects.Description: A ribbon the deep blue of a cloudless summer day awaits you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
On a cloudless summer day, the sky at its zenith is a deep, fathomless
blue.  That precise color is the color of this ribbon.  It is the
#bElysium#N color.

Objects.Name: deep blue navy ribbon
Objects.Description:
Deep blue, navy blue, off to roam the seas blue, this ribbon waits for
you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This very dark blue is the color of sailor's uniforms, of early night.
It is darker than first-prize blue, quieter than sky blue.

Objects.Name: aqua ribbon
Objects.Description: The aqua ribbon curls up on the ground, waiting to be worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The cheerful aqua ribbon is the color of a calm sea, or an aquatic
elf's eyes.

Objects.Name: turquoise ribbon
Objects.Description: A deep turquoise ribbon would look pretty in your hair.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An unusually dark turquoise ribbon is the ribbon seller's personal
favorite.  He sells quite a few to young lasses to braid into their
hair, and there was even one knight who wished it braided into his
horse's tail. Well, you know what they say about knights and their
horses!

Objects.Name: powdered bat dust wings spoonful
Objects.ShortDescription: a spoonful of powdered bat wings
Objects.Description: A small pile of gray dust should be swept up.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small amount of this sticky powder is all that is left of what used to
be the wings of a healthy vampire bat.  The bat is enchanted and fed
some powerful drugs over a period of several months.  His final feeding
is from an elven virgin (male or female).  His wings are then cut from
his body while he is still alive, carefully burned on an altar of
obsidian, then ground into this powder.

Objects.Name: lizard tongue
Objects.Description: The lizard's tongue looks like a shriveled black wand.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
What possible use could anyone have for the long forked tongue from a
lizard?  This one looks to have left it's original owner long ago, for
it has become dry and brittle and black.

Objects.Name: swampfire reeds torch
Objects.Description: Dry reeds have been tied together and dipped in magic.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The magic of a fire in the wet green swamplands has been captured in
this very utilitarian torch.  Light it to find your way through dark
caves or deep night.

Objects.Name: gypsy violin
Objects.Description: Amazing how innocent the violin looks when it isn't held.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In the right hands, this small violin can make you laugh or cry,
weaving powerful spells with its music.

Objects.Name: dangling gold earrings
Objects.Description: A pair of earrings form two gold circles on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A pair of bright golden earrings formed like circles will catch any
light available and shine.  These earrings are about 2" (5cm) in
diameter and quite thick.

Objects.Name: dead cockroach
Objects.Description: The cockroach sleeps on its back, six legs sticking up in the air.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This very ugly very dead cockroach has no real purpose except to
provide a little ugliness, should you find the need.  They are in
unfortunately plentiful supply.

Objects.Name: long voodoo pin
Objects.ShortDescription: a very long very sharp pin
Objects.Description: Watch out! don't step on the long, sharp pin!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This long pin was made to skewer a hat to a head or to stick in a wax
doll.  You could also stick it in a dead cockroach to mount it on your
wall, should you be so perverse.  It is probably posioned.

Objects.Name: horn ale
Objects.Description: The horn of ale lies on it side, spilling out its contents.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a long, slightly curved, hollowed out horn from a war cow that
unfortunately met its maker during the War Against the Evil Horde.  It
has been filled with a delicious cold ale for you to drink.  There is a
long leather strap for you to sling it across your back so that you
may refill it later with the beverage of your choice.

Objects.Name: wizardly wizard tunic
Objects.Description:
A black velvet tunic, strategically padded, has ties to attach
sleeves.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A heavy velvet was used to make this thickly padded tunic.  The tunic
is decorated with gold embroidery and mithril buttons.  It is designed
to be worn with a variety of different sleeves, although this wizard
only has one set...Have you seen them?

Objects.Name: captive evil blackhearted
Objects.Description: #YA blackhearted captive faces the dragon with arrogant bravado.#G

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
One of the many captives who made up the Evil Horde, this one is
waiting his turn to be dragon food.  He is truly an evil minotaur, so
evil that you can feel it in the air around him.  He is tall, with a
broad frame covered with heavy muscles, and he snarls at you as you
pass, revealing long, sharp white teeth.

Objects.Name: ebony steel dagger
Objects.ShortDescription: a steel dagger with an ebony handle
Objects.Description: Light gleams dully off a sharp steel blade.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ebony black handle of this steel dagger was chosen for its color,
black being less likely to show bloodstains.  The steel point is kept
very sharp despite its frequent use.

Objects.Name: spiderweb sleeves spider web
Objects.Description: Sleeves sewn from fabric woven by the Queen Spider make a gauzy pile.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The cloth for these sleeves was woven by the queen spider in gratitude
to a mage who protected her while she was busy laying her thousands of
eggs.  The tailor who stitched the sleeves found the cloth difficult to
cut and sew, but the result was a remarkable pair of sleeves that are
extremely strong, very magical, and very beautiful.

Objects.Name: merlins sword mystery
Objects.Description: A sword cloaked in mystery waits for a magic hand to wield it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It is said this ancient sword has been passed down from archmage to
archmage since first created deep in the mists of time.  It was forged
for the fabled Merlin, magician to King Arthur.  It is a small sword,
with a curved blade that owes its sharpness to magic rather than the
grindstone.

Objects.Name: ring ophiuchus serpent
Objects.Description: A faint hissing noise appears to be coming from a circle of silver.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A miniature snake formed of beautifully wrought silver winds around 
your finger.  The head coils up slightly from the ring, and the 
body of the serpent splits to form the circle of the ring.

Objects.Name: chain serpent ophiuchus necklace
Objects.Description: The Serpent of the 13th house will chain itself to your neck.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A strong silver chain crosses over your back from shoulder to shoulder,
serving to anchor the front of this silver necklace.  At each shoulder,
a silver serpent's tail coils into the end of the chain then curves
gracefully towards the middle.  The two tails join into the head of the
serpent, which points down towards earth.

Objects.Name: many-colored skirt
Objects.Description: A full skirt of many colors and textures has been cast aside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of many colors and many fabrics, one can sense that this skirt has
travelled further, seen more than most will in a lifetime.  The colors
and textures give the skirt life.

Objects.Name: belt chain waistchain
Objects.ShortDescription: a wood and brass linked waist chain
Objects.Description: Circles of wood and brass link together to form a chain.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Circles of alternating ebony and shiny brass connect to form a simple
length of chain to be used as a belt.

Objects.Name: blouse colors
Objects.Description: Many patterns and colors form the gypsy queen's blouse.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The blouse has been sewn of soft, old fabric.  The original fabric was
clearly quite bright, but time and sunshine have muted the colors to
softer shades.  The blouse is loosely gathered at the neck and wrists,
tied with a ribbon.
